notablePrerequisites: Phantom Flock does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Phantom Flock persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phantom Flock, adding {C}{C}.
When Phantom Flock dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with two +1/+1 counters on it due to its first ability.
Repeat.
